title: Berlin Museums Closed for Renovation - Quick Summary
items: **The Pergamonmuseum is completely closed and has been since October 2023.** There is no open entrance and no bookable ticket for it in the state museums' shop.
**The north wing reopens on 4 June 2027, and that date is firm.** It brings back the Pergamon Altar, the hall of hellenistic architecture and the entire Museum für Islamische Kunst in 25 new rooms.

**The Ishtar Gate is on a much longer clock.** It sits in the south wing, closed since 23 October 2023, which the museum expects to reopen around 2037. From 2027 only a selection of highlights moves into the north wing.

**Das Panorama beside the building is the nearest substitute.** Yadegar Asisi's 360 degree reconstruction of ancient Pergamon shown with masterpieces of the Antikensammlung, 14 euro, 7 reduced, free under 18.

**Museum Berggruen has been shut since 5 September 2022** for a full overhaul of the Stüler building, with no published reopening date. The Neue Nationalgalerie holds the rest of the classical modern collection.
**The Zeughaus and the German history overview exhibition are closed too.** The museum says no reliable reopening date can be given yet and that strip-out work runs into mid-2027.

**The Deutsches Historisches Museum's Pei building stays open every day from 10:00 to 18:00**, 7 euro for one exhibition, 10 euro for all, free under 18. It is one of the few central museums that opens on a Monday.
**Museum Island itself is open.** Neues, Altes, Bode and Alte Nationalgalerie are all running, and the James-Simon-Galerie entrance building never closed.
**Watch the closing days, not just the renovations.** The Humboldt Forum shuts on Tuesday and opens on Monday, and four smaller houses close on both Monday and Tuesday.
